scope: Numerical reconnaissance only, NOT a proof, nonexistence result, certified 2-block-positive witness or exact SN statement. It seeks non-range alternatives after frontier-20261028-both-grid-noninjective-range-barrier-v1.json SHA256 ac94b98ccb08e995cc75d37ad9af8e15eafcdb43b3d8d4589c9f402eee092e11.

realignment.criterion: For any normalized SN<=2 state, ||realignment(rho)||_1<=2 by the Schmidt decomposition and convexity. A violation would still require exact source/PPT and witness certification.
realignment.observed: Seed 20261028, each original source tested 3000 random complex 4x4-output local filter pairs then a 3000-step single-start hill climb. The 4x5 source had source score 1.0718829979682087, random best 1.0041308089173964, refined best 1.1711214438126152. The 5x5 source had source score 1.1427998067763423, random best 0.9826669877434103, refined best 1.0866692383283598. These are floating approximations and no >2 candidate was produced.

covariance.criterion: Liu et al., https://arxiv.org/html/2208.04909v3 Corollary 1, r=2: ||realignment(rho-rho_A tensor rho_B)||_1 <= 1+sqrt((1-tr(rho_A^2))*(1-tr(rho_B^2))). A positive violation would need exact certification and an explicit valid witness.
covariance.observed: Seed 2026102801, each source tested 3000 random 4x4-output maps and a 3000-step single-start hill climb. Source covariance gaps were approximately -0.9221836847847106 (4x5) and -0.8545920977391172 (5x5); best refined sampled gaps were -0.8288731223956581 and -0.8994472275342692, respectively. The script hash-pins and replays the realignment screen. No positive numerical gap was produced.

limits: The bounded random search, unoptimized local objective, floating SVD and these two criteria cannot rule out ANY other filter, non-range witness or SN>=3 state. No claim about global feasibility or optimum. No external models, GPU, native solver or publication were used.
